senses.gloss:
भतप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Causing or inspiring fear.
 E. भय and प्रद who or
what gives.

भात् mfn. (-भान्-भान्ती or -भाती-भात्) Shining splendid.
 E. भा to shine, शतृ aff.

भात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shone, bright, resplendent.
 m. (-तः) Morning,
dawn.
 E. भा to shine, aff. क्त.

भाति f. (-तिः)
 1. Light, brightness.
 2. Perception, knowledge.

भातु m. (-तुः) The sun.
 E. भा to shine, तुन् Unādi aff.

भातृद्वितीया f. (-या) The second day of the first-half of KĀRTIKA when
[]
sisters entertain their brothers in consequence of the Yamunā
once having entertained her brother Yama on that day.
